name: fix102_chest_marks
verifies: fix-102 ([owner]): a locked chest the hero focuses and cannot open (no lockpick) is recorded; fix-116 ([owner]: 'shown only by a filter'): the map page draws the marks only while its chest filter (fix-126: the chest button of the filter bar inside the map's top-right corner, default hidden, kept in PlayerPrefs) is on; the marks are small (13 px, 80 % opacity) and chests a few pixels apart are one mark with a count; a refused try keeps the mark; the mark survives save/load; once the hero picks the lock (perks + lockpick) and opens the chest the mark is gone and the map shows none
notes: lockedchest picks the nearest in-world chest with a shut difficulty-1 lock and no key and stands the hero 1.5 m from it ($chest = its entity name; chestmarked / chestlocked read that chest). chestmarks = marks recorded and shown-able (still locked, in the world), mapchestmarks = chests drawn on the open map page, mapchestgroups = marks drawn (nearby chests grouped), mapchestfilter = on/off of the filter bar's chest button ('hidden' without a map, '-' when another page is open). chestfilter (= mapfilter chests) clicks the filter bar's chest button while the map page is open (fix-126). Perk_LockPick_2 removes the CP 1.75 break chance at difficulty 1, so one lockpick opens it. The marks map is the largest carried map around the hero (docs gives every map). The filter is restored at the end of the run. Shots: compare fix116_map_filter_off/on (marks small, the filter bar inside the map's top-right corner, its chest button dimmed / lit).
